 Chicago Fire Season 15 Episode 6 Photos: “Over the Edge” Airs Tonight on NBC
 November 11, 2026 at 1:12 pm by Thomas Miller 
 Chicago Fire Season 15 Episode 6 photos preview “Over the Edge,” premiering tonight, Wednesday, November 11, at 9 p.m. ET/PT on NBC . The recruits reach their final day at Firehouse 51, Stella Kidd gets unexpected news, and the promo shows Kelly Severide directing a rescue high above the street.
 Taylor Kinney stars as Severide, with Miranda Rae Mayo as Kidd, Hanako Greensmith as Violet Mikami, Jocelyn Hudon as Lizzy Novak, and Da’Vinchi as Marcus Burke. The new stills show Burke alongside fellow recruits Hollis ( K.C. McNeil ) and Jansen ( Joe Eichorst ).
 What Is “Over the Edge” About? 
 While the recruits wrap up their time at 51, Kidd has news of her own to process. The episode preview keeps the details of what she learns under wraps. On the rescue call, the promo shows Severide giving orders from below before a mayday interrupts the operation.
 Violet and Novak start raising money for the Joint Duty Program, and an unexpected donation gives their effort a boost. The gallery includes the two paramedics together and a shot of Novak with Dustin, played by Nicholas Bishop .
